name: Nimue
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Nimue is an Arthurian heroine. Her Welsh name is sometimes given to the Lady of the Lake, who sponsored king Arthur from the Otherworld and made her home on an isle of women lost in the fairy mists. Nimue is also used as the given name of Merlin's lover. Merlin appears elsewhere with the half sister of the king, Morgause, whom some writers view as the lake lady. In other texts Viviane names the mage's lover. Such confusion is common when mythology passes by word of mouth.
